problems.reason: Both sentences state that a second juvenile specimen proved an elongated tail was present, not as long as the falsified tail of the holotype, measuring about 85% of the femur length.

Sentences 25 and 26 date the holotype to ~124.5–124.6 Ma (Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation), while sentence 27 suggests the holotype may actually come from Middle Jurassic deposits, directly contradicting the earlier age assignment.
